title: Oil Jumps as Hormuz Stays Shut After Trump Rebuffs Iran’s Offer
title_zh: 特朗普拒绝伊朗的提议后，霍尔木兹海峡保持关闭，油价上涨
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Oil surged after US President Donald Trump rejected Iran’s latest response to his proposal to end the war in the Middle East, prolonging the effective closure of the crucial Strait of Hormuz.Most Read from BloombergIran Makes New Offer on Uranium in Response to ...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——美国总统唐纳德·特朗普拒绝了伊朗对其结束中东战争提议的最新回应，延长了关键的霍尔木兹海峡的有效关闭时间，导致油价飙升。

title: Jim Cramer Says Nvidia Is 'Tough To Beat' On Corning Deal, Points Out Google, Amazon Still Have An 'Opponent With Multiple Legs Up'
title_zh: 吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramer) 表示，英伟达在康宁交易中“难以击败”，并指出谷歌、亚马逊仍然是“多条腿的对手”
summary: Nvidia Corp. has deepened its grip on the AI infrastructure race with a $500 million investment in Corning Inc., a move that addresses critical networking bottlenecks even as Amazon.com, Inc. and Alphabet Inc.'s Google intensify efforts to challenge its dominance....
summary_zh: Nvidia 公司向康宁公司投资 5 亿美元，加深了在人工智能基础设施竞赛中的控制力，此举解决了关键的网络瓶颈，尽管亚马逊公司和 Alphabet 公司旗下的谷歌加大了挑战其主导地位的力度。

title: Ripple (XRP) Has Closed 10 Major Deals This Year: Here’s the Scoreboard for Each Partnership
title_zh: Ripple (XRP) 今年已完成 10 笔重大交易：以下是每个合作伙伴的记分牌
summary: Ripple (CRYPTO: XRP) has closed ten major deals so far in 2026, partnering with Germany’s $1.6 trillion Deutsche Bank, JPMorgan, and Mastercard’s $9 trillion payment network.
summary_zh: Ripple（加密货币代码：XRP）截至 2026 年已完成十项重大交易，与德国价值 1.6 万亿美元的德意志银行、摩根大通以及万事达卡价值 9 万亿美元的支付网络合作。

title: Is the Trump Bull Market Running on Fumes? Following the Money -- All $8.2 Trillion of It -- Offers a Big Clue.
title_zh: 特朗普牛市正在冒烟吗？追踪资金——总共 8.2 万亿美元——提供了一条重要线索。
summary: This $8.2 trillion warning has reached a deafening tone.
summary_zh: 这个8.2万亿美元的警告已经达到了震耳欲聋的语气。

title: Apollo, Blackstone reportedly in talks for $35B Broadcom financing deal
title_zh: 据报道，Apollo 和 Blackstone 正在就 35B 美元 Broadcom 融资交易进行谈判
summary: Investing.com -- Apollo Global Management Inc. and Blackstone Inc. are in discussions with Broadcom Inc. regarding approximately $35 billion in financing to support the chipmaker’s artificial intelligence chip development, according to a Bloomberg report Friday.
summary_zh: Investing.com——据彭博社周五报道，阿波罗全球管理公司和黑石公司正在与博通公司讨论约 350 亿美元的融资，以支持该芯片制造商的人工智能芯片开发。
